how_chosen: Computed the specified smoothed distributions and solved nonnegative least squares on centered judge and human expected ratings; the cone projection gives the globally correlation-optimal nonnegative direction, which was normalized to sum to one. The training Pearson correlation is 0.830941054755640, confirmed by 102 simplex-constrained SLSQP runs. No SLSQP run improved on the projection; train_marginal was assigned zero because adding a constant prediction cannot improve Pearson correlation.
